Direction: **Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.**

**A: **While the most common belief is that these traits remain fixed, research studies show otherwise.

**B:** One such research study suggests that we can change our traits provided we want to change them.

**C:** We all possess certain personality traits that set us apart from the rest.

**D:** These traits, a mix of good and bad, define how we respond to situations and people.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"CDAB**".

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the sentence given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out.
 
• Part ‘A’ starts with the conjunction 'while'.
 
• Let us see some information about "While":
 __
 
• **"While"** is not used only used to introduce adverbial clauses of time. 
 
• In more formal usage, it is used to link or balance ideas that contrast each other:
 
 
 
• Part ‘B’ is providing the conclusion, and Part **'C' **is directly connected to Part **'D'**.
 
 
• Therefore the starting part is Part ‘C’.
 
 
 
• Part ‘D’ is the successor of Part **'C'** with as Part **'D'** is explaining about traits which are discussed in Part** 'C'**.
 
 
• Therefore, Part ‘D’ follows Part ‘C’.
 
 
 
• Part ‘A’ is giving further information about the subject.
 
 
• Therefore, Part ‘A’ follows Part ‘D’.
 
 
 
• Part ‘B’ is providing a conclusion to the context.
 
 
• **Therefore, Part ‘B’ follows Part 'A'.**
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct order is "CDAB__".​

__
 
• The given question is an example of Sentence Jumble. 
 
• We know that the first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• Here, in the given question **Part C** will be the first sentence because **it is the starting of an incident.*** 'In the week before the elections, trucks bumped up...' *the given sentence is clearly talking about **an election rally.** Therefore, it will be **the first sentence. **
 
• **Part C i**s talking about the* 'trucks bumped up and down...'.* It is talking about *'Vijay who was a bus conductor, and he was always there'. *
 
• **Part C** will be the next sentence because **Part A** tells us about the old job of** 'VIjay'** and he joined **politics**. Therefore, it will be the next sentence. 
 
• **Part D** will come last because it concludes who **'Vijay'** is. 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3. **

 ​

**Correct Answer:__** *In the week before the elections, trucks bumped up and down the dirty streets of Laxmangarh, full of young men holding microphones and shouting: "Stand up to the rich!". Vijay, the bus conductor, was always there in one of these trucks. He had now quit his old job and joined politics. questions.question:

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Active Voice.** As per the given question we have to change it into **Passive Voice. **
 
• The process of transformation as follows: 
 
 
• **'My friend' **is** the subject** of the given sentence. 
 
• **The object **of the given sentence is **'A very interesting story'. **
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• **'Narrated'** will be changed into **'was narrated'.** We know that in **Active to Passive transformation** **second form of verb** is changed into **'Was+V₃'. **
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3. **

 ​

**Correct Answer:__ ***A very interesting story was narrated by my friend at the International Storytelling Festival.​ *

questions.question: If a + b = 8 and ab = 12, then the value of a³ + b³ is:

a + b = 8, ab = 12

AP ⊥ BC

AQ is the angle bisector of ∠PAC

**Concept used:**

Sum of all angles of a triangle is 180°.

**Calculation:**

In ΔAPC,

AP ⊥ BC

⇒ ∠APC = 90° 

∠PCA = 30° (Given)

∠APC + ∠PCA + ∠CAP = 180° 

⇒ 90° + 30° + ∠CAP = 180° 

⇒ ∠CAP = (180° - 90° - 30°)

⇒ ∠CAP = 60° 

Now, ∠CAP = ∠PAQ + ∠CAQ

⇒ 60° = 2∠PAQ [∵ ∠PAQ = ∠CAQ (Given)]

questions.question: A higher _________ index represents inequality in income distribution.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gini.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gini index **measures the extent to which the distribution of income or consumption expenditure among individuals or households within an economy deviates from a perfectly equal distribution
 
• A Gini index of **0 represents perfect equality,** while an index of **100 implies perfect inequality.**
 
• A higher Gini index represents** inequality in income distribution.**
 
• As of 2011, the value for the Gini index estimated by the World Bank in India was **35.70.**
 
 
• India reached a minimum value of 31.70 in 1993.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• A **Lorenz curve **is used to represent income inequality or wealth inequality among countries.

 
 
• Lorenz curve was developed by** Max Lorenz **in 1905.
 
• Lorenz curve plots the cumulative percentages of total income received against the cumulative number of recipients, starting with the poorest individual or household.
 
• The Gini index measures the **area between the Lorenz curve**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• GDP stands for **Gross Domestic Product.**

 
 
• GDP is the value of all goods and services produced within a country during a given period.
 
 
 
• NDP stands for **Net Domestic Product.**
 
 
• NDP is equal to GDP minus depreciation.
 
 
 
• CPI stands for **Consumer Price Index.**
 
 
• CPI is a measure of the aggregate price level in an economy.
